name: WetSand
height_note: H 0..65535 spans height_range_m; mid level about 0.755

colour_spaces.N: linear, OpenGL (+Y up); flip green on Unreal import
colour_spaces.ORM: linear; R AO, G roughness, B metallic 0
colour_spaces.Macro: linear; R large, G medium, B small low-frequency variation, sample at 1/6 to 1/10 of the tile UV scale

method: Poly Haven damp_beach_sand with periodic wet sheen patches (darker, lower roughness); same hue as DrySand at lower value so the shoreline blend is only a value and gloss change
known_weaknesses: very plain; no shells or drainage rills (shells are the 3D scatter)
